label: NUP98::KDM5A

sections.text: NUP98 encodes a nuclear pore protein with an amino-terminal region involved in transport and transcriptional regulation.
KDM5A encodes a histone H3 lysine-4 demethylase and chromatin reader.

The fusion retains the amino-terminal FG-repeat region of NUP98 and creates an abnormal transcriptional regulator associated with sustained HOX-gene expression. The KDM5A partner contributes chromatin-reading regions; the fusion is enriched in young children and acute megakaryoblastic leukemia.
NUP98-rearranged pediatric AML has been associated with poor treatment outcomes in large cohorts; the strongest partner-specific evidence is for NSD1 and KDM5A.
